notes: Added the Inca Empire, missing from the 1492 source map.
Added the Aztec Triple Alliance as a state.
Mongolia was the Northern Yuan under Dayan Khan, not the Chagatai Khanate; the Chagatai remnant was Moghulistan.
The Kazakh Khanate (1465) held the eastern steppe; the Great Horde was the last remnant of the Golden Horde.
Greenland was unclaimed between the end of the Norse settlements and Danish recolonisation (1721).
Filled gaps in the source map from the nearest map (within 50 years).
Filled unclaimed land with peoples and cultures from neighbouring maps.
Named the remaining unclaimed regions after their regional peoples.
Java was not Malay sultanates: Majapahit ruled East Java, Madura and Bali until about 1527, and the Hindu Sunda Kingdom West Java until 1579.
